summary: Iteration 8 verifies the 3 new features: Custom Plan Editor (PUT /api/plans/current + GET /api/plans/exercise-suggestions), Notification Preferences (GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences), and Win-Back email (render_winback + winback in dispatcher + /emails/test winback). Backend: 26/26 pytest tests PASSED on the external preview URL (test_iter8_features.py) including all validation edge cases (empty days, no exercises, no name, 8 days, 16 exercises, auto-clamp to [1-20]/[1-100]/[0-1000]/[0-600]), legacy rest_sec accepted, version bump + source='user_edited' verified via subsequent GET, prefs round-trip, type coercion, winback Resend ID returned (alpha-fit.fitness verified), admin dispatcher returns 'winback' key. Regression: login, plans/current, sessions/start, notifications/settings, admin/stats, bodyscan/history, formcheck/history, and all 5 prior email templates (welcome/payment_success/trial_ending/streak_reminder/weekly_summary) still return Resend IDs. Frontend (Playwright on /plan + /settings as admin): BEARBEITEN button visible, edit mode shows plan-edit-name (text-white color rgb(255,255,255) confirmed — chrome-text bug is fixed) + plan-edit-notes + day-name-edit-1 + 4 exercise-edit rows on day 1 + add-exercise-btn-1 opens exercise-picker-1, plan-save-btn + plan-cancel-btn visible, cancel reverts to view mode. Settings shows all 3 cards (SOUND, PUSH-BENACHRICHTIGUNGEN, EMAIL-BENACHRICHTIGUNGEN) and all 4 email toggles (trial_ending, streak_reminder, weekly_summary, winback). Auto-save confirmed via toast 'Email-Einstellungen gespeichert' after toggle.

minor.issue: Pydantic-style validation not used — payload is `dict` and validated procedurally. Works correctly but error responses are German strings only (no machine-readable error code). Consider Pydantic model for OpenAPI schema completeness.

Validation is lossy — non-bool payload values are silently coerced via bool() (e.g. string 'false_string' becomes True). No 400/422 error returned. Acceptable per spec ('PUT validates types booleans only' — interpreted here as final-state guarantee, not strict-rejection). Document or strict-validate as needed.

issues: Email-toggle component lacks aria-pressed/role=switch — purely visual indicator. Hurts accessibility + automated testing. Recommend adding role=switch + aria-checked on the EmailToggle wrapper.

action_items: (Optional) Add role=switch + aria-checked to the EmailToggle component so the toggle state is exposed to assistive tech and Playwright (currently only visible via CSS — not testable via attribute).
(Optional) Strict-validate /api/notifications/preferences PUT payload — return 422 if a field is not a bool, instead of silent bool() coercion.
(Optional) Wrap PUT /api/plans/current payload in a Pydantic model (PlanEditRequest) so OpenAPI doc shows the schema and FastAPI handles 422s consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: render_winback in email_service.py is fully self-contained and returns (subject, html) tuple consistent with other templates — good.

Dispatcher idempotency for winback is enforced via db.email_log lookup ({user_id, template:'winback'}) — solid. Note that this is GLOBAL idempotency (once a user gets a winback they never get another) which is correct semantics.
_email_pref helper centralizes the prefs gate — used consistently for trial/streak/weekly/winback in server.py. No regression risk.

Server.py is now 1090 lines (up from 855 in iter7) — winback block adds ~40 lines. Still within reasonable bounds but the email dispatcher (4 blocks: trial/streak/weekly/winback) is a candidate for extraction into email_dispatcher.py.
Plan editor backend correctly accepts both 'rest_seconds' and legacy 'rest_sec' keys — verified in test_edit_plan_bumps_version_and_source.
Plan editor uses str(...)[:N] truncation for free-text fields (name, notes, exercise name, target_muscle, notes) — defensive and good.
Frontend chrome-text + transparent text-fill gradient previously made edit inputs invisible — confirmed fixed; getComputedStyle on plan-edit-name returns rgb(255,255,255).

Frontend EmailToggle (Settings.jsx ~349) is a `<button>` but the visual toggle has no aria-checked. Recommend converting to a `<button role="switch" aria-checked={value}>` for both a11y and testability.

rca of the issue: No bugs uncovered. Initial Playwright toggle-state detection returned None for aria-pressed — root cause: EmailToggle uses a plain <button> with custom div-based visual indicator, no aria-checked/aria-pressed attribute. This is a TESTING gap, not a product bug — the auto-save did persist (confirmed via 'Email-Einstellungen gespeichert' toast in screenshot and via the backend pref-roundtrip test against a fresh user). Recommended fix: add role='switch' aria-checked={value} to EmailToggle for a11y + future Playwright reliability.
